name: Todo
description: Session task checklist — prompt-gated plan surface (model decides when to use).

function.name: todo
function.description:
Manage your task list for the current session. Use for complex tasks with 3+ steps or when the user provides multiple tasks. Call with no parameters (or omit todos) to read the current list.

Writing:
- Provide 'todos' array to create/update items
- merge=false (default): replace the entire list with a fresh plan
- merge=true: update existing items by id, add any new ones

Each item: {id: string, content: string, status: pending|in_progress|completed|cancelled}
List order is priority. Only ONE item in_progress at a time.
Mark items completed immediately when done. If something fails, cancel it and add a revised item.

When to use:
- Multi-step work spanning several tool calls
- After new multi-step instructions, capture requirements as todos
- Mark exactly one item in_progress before starting; mark completed immediately when finished

When NOT to use: single-shot Q&A, trivial one-step replies, pure conversation.
Avoid churn: do not re-call when nothing meaningful changed.

Always returns JSON {todos, summary}. The UI renders this as a live checklist.

todos.description: Task items to write. Omit to read the current list. Pass [] to clear.

merge.description: true: update existing items by id, add new ones. false (default): replace the entire list.
